page.overview:
Who is Kumira Dhoran?

Kumira was a handsome with blue eyes, graceful hands and short dark brown hair. She was 5'5" tall. She preferred strong woolens over silk, but would sometimes wear a silk scarf. She sometimes gets ink stains on her clothes, but she would deal with them as soon as she could.

Like many of the Brown Ajah, Kumira could become easily absorbed in her studies, sometimes to the exclusion of the world around her. She had a reputation of aggressively pursuing those things of which she had taken an interest.

Unlike most Browns, she is also hard-headed, practical, observant and very strong-willed. She is interested in everything and doesn't like wasting time.

She was not afraid to swear, sometimes using the word "peace" as if it were an oath. She takes care not to offend anyone on purpose, even those of a lower status than hers; in fact, she is often more considerate of those with lower status, such as when she debates with Daigian over logic.
